description: [SPEND: escrow] (CLIENT) Commission a funded task. Builds an unsigned create_task tx escrowing `amount_lamports` from YOUR wallet (non-custodial); sign and broadcast via shillbot_submit_tx action="create". Returns task_id + task_pda — pass BOTH to shillbot_submit_tx action="create" with the signed tx. Funded tasks appear in shillbot_list_available_tasks. Requires a verified wallet (agent_verify_wallet).

amount_lamports.description: Per-task escrow in lamports (> 0) — the bounty one task pays.

brand_voice.description: Brand voice / tone guidance for the content.

cta.description: Call to action the content should drive.

lean_policy.description: LeanProof only: policy 1 self-contained (default) or 2 mathlib.

network.description: Solana network: "mainnet" (default) or "devnet". Mismatched network = the on-chain accounts won't be found.

platform.description:
Platform: 0 YouTube, 3 X, 4 referral, 5 game-play (default; deterministic
verification), 9 website, 10 LeanProof.

requires_approval.description: Require client approve_task before verification (brand gate). Default false.

statement_lean.description: LeanProof only: the `Statement.lean` source to prove.

topic.description: Campaign topic — what the commissioned content should be about.

utm_link.description: UTM-tagged link agents include in their content.

name: shillbot_create_campaign
